text:
carmen (marketing): Quick idea  launching ForgeKit Starter Pack (OSS refapp + 15m hands-on). Channels: blog, gated webinar, short clips, reproducible bench. Target date: 2 weeks. Need bench narrative, webinar hook, and inbound routing.

ben (devrel): Love it. For the benchmark story: pick one real workload (customer-support triage), show cold vs warm cache p50/p95 and cost-per-1k. Add one clear sentence "what this means for product teams."

leo (growth): RSVP gating: single Q: "you're building for" -> (prototype / production / infra). Route into three nurture tracks. Use utm_source per channel and tag leads `forgekit_rsvp`.

sophie (engineer): Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/forgekit-starter. Bench command: `./bench/quickbench.sh --concurrency 10 --seq 128 --save report.json`. Output JSON and CSV.

harper (events): Webinar: 30m (12 demo, 8 bench walkthrough, 10 Q&A). Wed 11am PT to hit EU. Speakers: carmen + ben demo, sophie infra notes. We'll make a 60s teaser clip for socials.

deploy-bot: Preview site live: https://forgekit-preview.redwood.ai  build #501 OK :rocket:

ben (devrel): Draft microcopy: Blog blurb: "ForgeKit Starter Pack: an OSS refapp that gets you from clone to production-ready benchmark in 15 minutes. Includes demo scripts, Docker, and k8s manifest."

Tweet: "New: ForgeKit Starter Pack  a 15m OSS refapp + reproducible benchmark. Live demo Wed 11am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/forgekit (utm=tw)"

carmen (marketing): tweak: shorten Tweet and call out "reproducible benchmark" explicitly. Also add CTA to blog: "Run the benchmark yourself."

leo (growth): Routing plan: landing page -> /workflows/forgekit-webinar. Tag `forgekit_webinar_rsvp`. Post-webinar email sequence: immediate with repo + report, 48h follow-up segmented by track. I'll set UTMs and tracking.

sophie (engineer): Live demo will run `./bench/quickbench.sh --save report.json && aws s3 cp report.json s3://redwood-forgekit/reports/`. Sample report: {"p50_ms": 34, "p95_ms": 88, "cost_per_1k": "$0.10"}. We'll add instance note (dev: g5, prod: a100).

harper (events): Ops checklist: 1) landing page + RSVP form 2) slides + demo rehearsal 3) teaser clip 4) UTMs + tracking 5) infra on-call. Who owns slides?

carmen (marketing): I'll own slides + blog. ben you own demo script & benchmark narrative. leo owns registration funnel + tags. sophie infra + report format. harper events ops.

ben (devrel): I'll add 3 short prompts to highlight caching/batching differences (cold vs warm). Also record a 90s demo cut during rehearsal.

leo (growth): A/B test idea for post-webinar subject lines: A) "Your ForgeKit benchmark & starter pack" B) "How we hit 34ms p50  ForgeKit results". I'll run 50/50 and report opens.

sophie (engineer): Note: results depend on model size and instance; include a tiny table mapping instance -> expected p50 range. Also include the exact command used for reproducibility.

ben (devrel): Can we capture a short JSON snippet from the bench and attach it to the follow-up email? e.g., `{"p50_ms":34,"p95_ms":88,"cost_per_1k":"$0.10"}`. Good for credibility.

harper (events): Rehearsal scheduled Tue 30m block. Confirm availability.

carmen (marketing): Confirmed. Quick messaging test: landing page CTA copy A/B: "Get the starter pack & results" vs "Clone the repo + see the benchmark". Which converts better?

leo (growth): I'll A/B test CTA 50/50. My hunch: shorter CTA wins.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: 2026-07-FORGEKIT-01. Reminder set for speakers.

carmen (marketing): Thanks team  next sync Mon 11am PT to finalize assets. Drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
